classificationBoundaries.classic: Only compatibility-preserving changes; unsupported schema/logic changes fail closed.
classificationBoundaries.custom: Host-authorized Reforged content changes may be staged and published.
classificationBoundaries.ai: Host-authorized AI-world content changes remain explicitly versioned.
classificationBoundaries.testRealm: Only environment allowed to live reload staged changes.

safeFallback: Reject unauthorized, stale, nonvalidated, Classic-incompatible, or non-test live-reload requests.
